messages:
morgan_ops: Noticed a 2-3s audio offset and a couple micro-dropouts during the product demo at ~15:02. Recorder on record02 has segment gaps. Live stream still up but AV slightly out of sync. @riley can you triage?

riley: On it. Flipped stream to RTMP fallback to avoid encoder overload. OBS shows main encoder spike, backup encoder now handling output.

devin: Grabbed record02 logs: recorderd worker was OOM-killed at 2026-03-23T15:02:09Z, then systemd restarted it. Snippet: 
```
Mar 23 15:02:09 record02 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4211 (recorderd-wo) score 987
Mar 23 15:02:12 record02 systemd[1]: recorderd.service: restarted successfully
```

infra-bot: infra-alert: memory pressure detected on record02; pack restarted. Recommend investigating memory limits for recorderd. Ticket INFRA-7421 opened.

morgan_ops: Riley, start rsync of any written segments to s3 and mark partials. Keep originals retained.

riley: Running `rsync -av --partial /mnt/recordings/tmp/ s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record02/tmp/` now. ETA ~3m. Will post link when done.

jen (CEO): Do not pause Q&A. Keep collecting audience questions and timestamps. We'll answer missed ones after. Legal/Comms need the transcript when available.

qa-lyn: I'll scrape chat + Q&A sheet. Two audience Qs around 15:01 and 15:03 may have been affected: "timeline for infra SLA improvements?" and "written migration plan?" I'll add both to follow-up list.

stream-monitor: monitor: AV sync delta peaked +3.2s at 15:04, packet loss 0.5% rising to 1.2% for a short window. Captions switched to internal ASR fallback.

morgan_ops: Action items: 1) Riley upload spliced segments and iso to s3 (done ASAP), 2) Postmortem draft (morgan_ops) by EOD, 3) Follow-up Q list to leadership (qa-lyn) within 1hr, 4) Infra to investigate OOM (eng-infra). If anyone has local clips to preserve, paste S3 paths here. :white_check_mark:
